designationHistory.name: Long Lake Migratory Bird Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Established Feb. 25, 1932, as the Long Lake Migratory Bird Refuge by Executive Order 5808, signed by President Herbert Hoover.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Long Lake National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 5808, Feb. 25, 1932 (lands in Burleigh and Kidder counties, N. Dak.; APP title misprints "North Carolina")
Federal Register: Long Lake NWR Complex notice, July 10, 2006 (established Feb. 25, 1932, by Hoover through Executive Order)
FWS ServCat: I&M plan, Long Lake NWR Complex (EO 5808)

review.note: Confirmed. EO 5808 describes its lands as an addition to a refuge "being acquired" under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act; FWS treats it as the establishing order.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: The Refuge was established on February 25, 1932 by President Herbert Hoover to provide sanctuary and habitat for migratory birds that use the Central Flyway migration corridor.
